summary: Completed comprehensive testing of multi-domain SEO implementation for animemomentsofficiel.fr and animeofficiel.fr. All backend endpoints, static SEO assets, frontend metadata, and catalog indexing verified successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: SEO export endpoint returns both alternate domains (animemomentsofficiel.fr, animeofficiel.fr)
Backend: SEO export endpoint returns catalogCount of 1500 items
Backend: Search Console status endpoint returns all 3 properties (lovanet.fr, animemomentsofficiel.fr, animeofficiel.fr)
Backend: Search Console status endpoint returns 12 sitemaps including alternate domain sitemaps
Backend: Search Console submit endpoint gracefully handles api_access_not_configured state (expected behavior)
Static Assets: All sitemap XML files are valid (sitemap.xml, sitemap-catalog.xml, sitemap-pages.xml, sitemap-images.xml, sitemap-videos.xml, sitemap-products.xml, sitemap-news.xml, sitemap-books.xml)
Static Assets: Alternate domain sitemap indexes exist (sitemap-animemomentsofficiel-fr.xml, sitemap-animeofficiel-fr.xml)
Static Assets: Catalog sitemap contains 1500 items split across 2 chunks (1000 + 500)
Static Assets: Catalog URLs use crawlable anime-catalog?anime= format
Static Assets: structured-data.json contains both alternate domains in sameAs array
Static Assets: structured-data.json contains aggregateRating (4.8/5, 1284 reviews)
Static Assets: structured-data.json contains review
Frontend: Exactly one google-site-verification tag present in index.html
Frontend: Alternate domains meta tag present with both domains
Frontend: Both alternate domain link tags present (rel=alternate)
Frontend: JSON-LD includes both alternate domains in Organization sameAs
Frontend: JSON-LD includes aggregateRating (4.8/5, 1284 reviews)
Frontend: JSON-LD includes review in Organization
Frontend: No duplicate critical meta tags (canonical, description, keywords, robots)
Frontend: Catalog page (anime-catalog?anime=16498) includes anime parameter in canonical URL
Frontend: Catalog page alternate domain links include anime parameter
Frontend: Catalog page JSON-LD WebPage includes anime parameter in URL
Frontend: Page title is specific to anime (Attack on Titan) on catalog pages

additional_notes.google_search_console_api: Search Console API is disabled on project dynamic-cove-502914-u0. This is expected and documented. The backend correctly returns api_access_not_configured status with activation URL.
additional_notes.catalog_coverage: Catalog sitemap contains 1500 anime entries using crawlable URLs (anime-catalog?anime=ID). Entries are split across 2 chunk files for optimal sitemap size.
additional_notes.multi_domain_coverage: Both alternate domains (animemomentsofficiel.fr and animeofficiel.fr) are present in: meta tags, link tags, JSON-LD sameAs, backend endpoints, and dedicated sitemap indexes.
additional_notes.minor_fix_applied: Removed duplicate meta tags from /app/frontend/public/index.html to prevent conflicts with dynamic LocalizedHead component. Only google-site-verification tag remains in static HTML as required.
additional_notes.og_locale_alternate: Multiple og:locale:alternate tags (7) are intentional and correct for multi-language support - one for each supported locale.
